title: judgment-memory.record
description: One persisted outcome of a Judgment Day lineage (see skills/judgment-day/SKILL.md + skills/_shared/review-ledger-contract.md). This is the payload judgment-memory/ledger.py writes to SQLite, embeds, and upserts into Qdrant — and the shape jd_recall returns.

execution_id.description: Stable id for this judgment run, e.g. 'jd-001' or the review-ledger transaction's lineageId.

project.description: Same project scoping convention TonyMem uses (git-remote-derived by the plugin).

task.description: Short description of what was judged, e.g. 'optimize query', 'refactor API'.

type.description: Reserved for future record kinds; judgment-memory only ever writes 'judgment' today.

agreement.description: Output of the Agreement Engine: 'confirmed' = both judges agree, 'suspect' = one judge only, 'contradiction' = judges disagree (routes to human escalation, never auto-fixed — see review-ledger-contract.md).

winner.description: Which judge's verdict the Agreement Engine sided with, if applicable. Null on contradiction.

confidence.description: Agreement Engine confidence score for the final decision.

final.description: Terminal outcome. Mirrors review-ledger-contract.md's transaction.state terminal values (approved/escalated), collapsed to the fix agent's vocabulary.

fix.description: One-line summary of the fix applied, if any (e.g. 'added index').

lesson.description: The reusable takeaway — this is the field embedded and searched. Should stand alone without the rest of the record for recall to be useful.

source_lineage_id.description: Pointer back to the review-ledger-contract.md transaction.lineageId this record was derived from, if run through the standard Judgment Day skill.
